skill.summary: Generate expressive talking-head videos from static images using Kameo AI. Converts static avatars/portraits into dynamic 5-second videos with realistic facial expressions, lip-sync, and motion. Use when you need to bring static images to life, create AI character videos, demonstrate visual communication, or generate talking avatars from photos.
